title: Rename PBI embedded pages
summary: 127 Power BI report pages were renamed to standardize their page names across finance, inventory, manufacturing, projects, purchasing, sales, subscription billing, and sustainability modules.
key_points: Page names for 127 embedded Power BI reports were updated
Changes span multiple business modules including finance, inventory, manufacturing, and projects
The renaming improves naming consistency across Power BI report pages
File modifications only involved page name updates in AL files
